data.leadership_messages: 1. The IIR#2 Execution Review was conducted on 15 July 2026. On 16 July, the team identified a critical gap in the required task documentation. Although a continuous search and retrieval effort was maintained from 17 July through 3 August, ongoing document updates by external stakeholders made assessing these shifting requirements highly challenging.2. CA includes 13 child tasks. 3. Based on the WBS descriptions of the child tasks, we are unable to ascertain whether any of the originally provided CA data provided by NG on 4/16/26 is integrated into this CA. Based on discussions with NG on 8/4/26, the data previously tracked by the SPO from April ’26 has either been deleted, reassigned, redistributed, or rolled into other WBS elements due to duplicability. For awareness, we have listed those CAs below:
data.rationale: Data sets constantly changing from day-to-day making it difficult to understand long-term scope impacts. The team can only conduct analysis based on the most current data. Would meet the requirements of IIR#2. Beyond that will be more challenging.

areas.text: This element covers tasks required to complete the Command Systems (CS) Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (SEIT) owned Systems Engineering (SE) specific to the MMIII STRATCOM Key Distribution Center (MMIII SKDC) Node.MS&A:This element covers tasks required to complete the Command Systems (CS) Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (SEIT) owned Technical Baseline Development and Management documented in the Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP) and the Configuration Management Plan (CMP) specific to system analysis, modeling, and simulation. This scope includes technical baseline artifacts to define and produce the analysis artifacts to assess and substantiate the design mapping to specific Configuration Items (CI) and Computer Software Configuration Items (CSCI) and the required CDRL artifact packages in Table B-1 in Annex B. Additional scope is to develop, maintain, and execute the Modeling and Simulation Master Plan (MSMP) which describes how the following analysis activities are to be performed, documented, and delivered: Analysis used for requirements development, decomposition and allocation; analysis used for requirements verification and validation (V&V); analysis supporting pre- and post-test activities; analysis supporting anomaly and failure investigations; analysis supporting development of U.S. Strategic Command (USSTRATCOM) force planning factors; product support analysis, and manufacturing and deployment analysis. Finally, tasks associated with the Verification and Validation Plan, per MIL-STD 3022 Documentation of Validation, and Accreditation (VV&A) for analytical and simulation tools identified as subject to accreditation in the approved MSMP.MMIII Systems Engineering:This element contains the resources associated with the node-level systems engineering and oversight of lower-level content to ensure a successful integration including technical planning, technical management, analysis, and support efforts for development and production activities of the node-level capabilities. The systems engineering entity is responsible for the analysis, derivation, allocation, and traceability, of requirements, design, and interfaces. The technical work that is a part of this package is for the maturation of requirements, architecture, Risk Management Framework (RMF) decomposition, incorporating Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis (MS&A), and verification planning in accordance with the MMIII SLC Verification Plan. This element also includes the work necessary to integrate, plan, and execute MMIII Major Program Events to include MMIII CDR and events enabling MMIII DIOC. Additionally, node-level systems engineering support to system certification activities including cyber security, nuclear surety, and airworthiness are included in this element.
NG is working toward integration into P6. Final determination can be assessed once full integration is completed. Until that point, the SPO must use currently available resources.
Product element applies solely to KDC elements.
